data.summary:
**When:** [Your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), after you have completed a Contract of [Murderous Agenda](vsdata:ability/drukhari.kabalite-cartel.murderous-agenda).

**Target:** An **ARCHON WARLORD** of yours.

**Effect:** Pick a new Contract from the [Murderous Agenda](vsdata:ability/drukhari.kabalite-cartel.murderous-agenda) list, even one you completed before. Then pick an enemy unit on the battlefield that fits the new Contract's description. Until you complete that Contract, that enemy unit counts as your Contract unit, and [Murderous Agenda](vsdata:ability/drukhari.kabalite-cartel.murderous-agenda) applies as usual.
